messages:
maria: quick check — can we land PR #2998 before the nightly deploy freeze? CI has a flaky integration test but i reran once and it passed. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2998
alex: what's the risk window? do we have a rollback if the canary spikes? :thinking_face:
maria: low-risk change (config toggle + small routing fix). rollback is just flip the flag and revert is fast. i want to avoid waiting for tomorrow's rebase window if possible.
sam: i can monitor the canary for 15m after deploy. happy to be on-call for that slot. :+1:
reviewer-lee: i left one tiny comment on the latency metric naming, otherwise LGTM. can someone give eyes on the CI flake root cause?
jordan: CI logs show a transient db conn timeout in integration-5, looks like test harness hit a rate limit. i think rerunning with warmed cache helps.
maria: ok let's do a controlled land: canary -> monitor -> staggered roll. need a CI snapshot (full matrix) success before we flip the toggle.
alex: agreed. request: trigger a priority rerun of the matrix, add a quick smoke job to the canary that hits the new route.
ci-bot: CI snapshot requested by @alex for PR #2998. Matrix jobs queued: 12. Priority: high. Run id: 202105-2998-823
alex: command to trigger locally for reference:
```
ci rerun --pr 2998 --matrix --priority=high --smoke=canary
```
ci-bot: Run 202105-2998-823 started. queued jobs: 12. estimated time ~8m.
maria: tagging @sam and @jordan — please watch the canary once the build finishes. i'll hold the merge until matrix + smoke pass.
ci-bot: Run 202105-2998-823 finished: matrix=success, smoke=flaky(integration-5) -> rerun smoke job 3/3 succeeded. Summary: PASS.
reviewer-lee: thanks — re-review done, naming nit resolved. approves.
alex: ok merging once i see remote green. will use the staged canary rollout with 10% traffic -> 100% after 15m if no errors.
maria: merging now. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2998 :tada:
sam: monitoring: no errors in first 5m, latency stable. continuing monitor for 10 more.
jordan: looks good from infra side, no unexpected autoscale.
ci-bot: Deploy to canary started by @alex. deploy-id: canary-202105-2998.
ci-bot: Canary rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% complete. No alerts.
maria: thanks everyone. note: we'll add an explicit smoke retry in the test harness to avoid this flake next time. created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/issues/512
alex: nice. moving to close-of-day checklist. :rocket:
